& gt ; * * caps * * is a drinking game that was started in glendive , mt it involves throwing [ bottle caps ] ( http : / / en . wikipedia . org / wiki / bottle _ cap ) or pennies into 16oz plastic cups ( north america , north europe , and argentina ) , or at other bottle caps balanced on open beer bottles ( france ) . & gt ; four players split into two teams seated 8 to 16 feet apart ( butts behind the cup ) , with a 16 oz red solo cup filled with beer between each team member on each side . each side take turns throwing 1 cap each into their opponents ' cup . each time a team makes a shot , the other team gets a chance to " top it " or " match the shot " by making a shot . the score continues to increase until someone misses . for example four shots back to back equal four points . if no top is made , the team that made the original shot or last top gets the points while the other team must drink a full beer between them . however , if a top is made , the team which originally made the shot tries to make a top as well . this exchange continues until a top shot is missed , at which point the team that missed drinks its beer and a point or points may be awarded to the team that made the last successful shot . the game then continues with both teams taking turns shooting . the first team to a baker ' s dozen with at least a two - point lead wins . & gt ; there ' s a few other factors aside from just the fact that men tend to have more body mass . for starters women also tend to have a higher percentage of body fat that men , and less muscle mass . fat has less water content which means it generally takes less alcohol to get the same bac for a women vs . a man of the same weight . on top of that , there ' s an enzyme in the stomach / liver called adh ( alcohol dehydrogenase ) . adh ' s job is to break down alcohol . according to wikipedia : [ young women are unable to process alcohol at the same rate as young men because they do not express the adh as highly , although , the inverse is true among the middle - aged ] ( http : / / en . wikipedia . org / wiki / alcohol _ dehydrogenase # human ) that said i ' m 175lbs , and i have a female friend that is maybe 110lbs that can drink me under the table . * * tldr : biological factors make it harder to get a man to the same bac as a women even if height / weight are same . science ! * * ( doen ' t mean biologically * better * unless better = takes more alcohol to get drunk ) edit : damn . there are apparently a few other alcoholic biologists on / r / drunk . however , this post took a whole 15min of my life so i can ' t bring myself to delete it .

this is the real reason that you are instructed never to drink alcohol if you are in a situation where you are at risk of freezing to death . when the body gets cold , it begins slowing blood flow to the extremities by contracting blood vessels in order to keep your body heat confined to your core , where it is needed . alcohol is a vasodilator , meaning that it opens up these blood vessels and allows blood to flow from your core back to your extremities , which carries the heat away from your core and allows it to dissipate more rapidly . then , you die . however , drinking and fucking around in the snow like the person in op ' s picture is obviously doing , when not at risk of hypothermia , is a ton of fun .

australian drinking culture is hard to understand . its much closer to europe than the us . we are taught from a young age to understand and respect alcohol , not to fear it . we grow up going to bbq ' s with people drinking around us and we might be offered a sip of beer , once you get a bit older you might even get offered a beer for yourself . i ' m talking 13 - 14 here , old enough to understand what alcohol is and if they want to accept a drink . most people here start drinking around 15 - 16 , either having their parents provide a small amount of alcohol to drink in a controlled environment , or by getting someone older to buy it for them . my first time getting smashed was at a 16th birthday party . i was also 16 at the time and i drank three bottles of passion pop , an extremely cheap sparkling wine . by the time i was 18 ( the legal drinking age ) i was already a fairly adequate drinker , able to handle my alcohol in a bar setting and have yet to make a fool of myself in public .

this is bullshit . being australian , or irish , or whatever nationality has a reputation for being drunk a lot has no relevance to whether you are an alcoholic or not . if the overall effect of your use of this chemical is positive , you are not an alcoholic , if it is negative , you are an alcoholic . if you are an alcoholic , you can beat the addiction and find the right balance , for some that is no alcohol , for some that is a little bit on some occasions , for some it is a a moderate amount , etc . if you are not an alcoholic , you may still be able to improve the amount of alcohol you drink . whether that means drinking a bit more to let loose , or drinking less to gain control , you should drink the right amount regardless of nationality or stereotype .

( 1 ) buzz . your skin has a tingle that you almost didn ' t notice , and your thoughts are a little slowed . this feels good , but your speech is still fine , and your motor control has diminished at an almost imperceptible degree . your eyes look a little more relaxed than normal ; socializing is the best here . ( 2 ) you can feel an increased buzz . you sense of balance is slightly distorted and it rarely effects how you travel , but your finer movements that require greater dexterity have diminished more . you can pull your shit together to have a decent conversation with your mother , unless she ' s dead . ( 3 ) this is the prime state to be in . you are officially " drunk " . the previous two levels were just a buzzes ; this is the real deal . you occasionally stumble , and you have varying degrees of impaired speech ( this is dependent upon the attention you allot to your speech ; some people can still talk fine during this stage . ) your vision is adequately blurred , but you can still watch arrested development . mind you , you ' ll need to re - watch these episodes because you missed some of the finer details . you remember almost all of the big details during this phase . you say a few things that are considered uncouth , but you don ' t generally ruin relationships with what you ' re willing to say during this level . ( 4 ) the fun times are behind you . . . mostly ? yeah , definitely for now . most things are a blur , and you remember less than a majority of the important details . you have lost your connection to the god of social graces . what the fuck are you even saying ? your words are recognizable , but they are mostly apologetic for whatever atrocities you are currently committing or the ones you ' re about to do . you can postpone drinking at this point and fall back into level 3 . and decline from there , but then you could still be on your way to level 5 . because you drank so much . there is a chance that you could have a mild blackout during this part . you remember about half of the night . this is a little ambiguous because the semi - blackout is between 4 . and 5 . the guy who wrote this could be a little drunk . gt brother president brothers and sistersgt  gt recently i posted an article written by someone much smarter than i concerning study habits  as the author noted many students come to college with absolutely no idea how to study  and thus they suffer the consequences  i believe the same holds true for the consumption of alcohol  while i dont promote the consumption of alcohol its your choice alone i do want to give you a few tips i have discovered many times the hard way to drink wisely if you choose to drink at all  this will help you avoid embarrassing situations gt  gt 1 obey the laws  im a lawyer so i certainly couldnt tell you to drink underage could i  while i disagree with the noneall approach we have regarding the drinking age laws preferring a learners license type approach of slow and supervised initiation the status quo is the law  and its violation could lead you into an embarrassing situation that you will have to explain away to your employers for the rest of your life  as for drinking and driving thats selfexplanatory so dont do itgt  gt if you are still reading i assume you are over 21 and will obey all other laws  otherwise return to suggestion number 1 gt  gt 2  if you do drink drink top shelf alcohol  i dont say this so you can look cool  instead there are several good reasons for drinking only more expensive brands  first while price and quality dont automatically go hand in hand they often do  and higher quality alcohol has fewer impurities  this means less productivityloss due to hangovers because of less severe hangovers  it also means the drinks taste and your buzz will be better which in turn  will cause you less temptation surprisingly to drink quickly ie to the point the sickly buzz is replaced by numbness and the foul taste of the swell youre drinking is eliminated  thats why good alcohol is often referred to as sippin alcohol because you want to sit and savor it slowly  on the other hand cheap alcohol is called chugging alcohol and will lead to extreme drunkenness  next top shelf is more expensive  since your money isnt unlimited expensive alcohol also means you are less financially able to become drunk  after all 30 will only buy you a certain amount of makers or woodford reserve but it would buy you alot more pbr enough to become embarrassingly drunk  with that in mind always take a predetermined amount of cash with you and 15 emergency money for a cab ride  never ever take your credit or debit cards  third more expensive brands of alcohol are more likely to be measured for each drink when poured than inexpensive brands  bar owners are less likely to become angry if a bartender gives a generous portion of cheap hooch to a patron than they would be if that generous portion is an expensive brand  because expensive alcohol will be measured before being served you will know how much alcohol is in your drink  see suggestion 3 for why this is important  also less generous helpings means you are less likely to get too intoxicatedgt  gt 3 always always know how much you have consumed and pace yourself accordingly  an easy way to do this is to drink from a premeasured container or mix your own drinks  if you dont then at least watch the person making your drink  to be safe always roughly over estimate how much alcohol you have had  also there a plenty of websites devoted to the metabolism rate of alcohol for someone your gender age and weight  a rough rule of thumb is one beer or shot per hour  however keep in mind that everyone is different and your bodys ability to breakdown alcohol actually slows down the more you drink  so if you find yourself intoxicated stop drinking  dont try to pace at that point gt  gt 4 never do shots unless absolutely the last resort that you cant avoid  and never do shots chased by alcohol  use the old rule parents gave their kids about eating and then swimming  wait at least 30 minutes after a shot to see what it does to your system before even thinking about having another drink  i am thoroughly convinced some shots will hide in your system and wont kickin until much much latter  so dont think just because you had one shot and felt nothing that you can immediately take another  instead you may have all those shots hit you at once later on  for beer drinkers one great excuse to avoid shots is to say to peer pressure that shots ruin the taste of your beer and you dont waste beer  same excuse can be used if you like mixed drinks but works best for beer drinkers  if all else fails and you have a shot immediately chase with a glass of water to dilute the shot and have it enter your system more smoothly  otherwise it may hit you all at once and you could find yourself going from stone cold sober to babbling drunk in minutesgt  gt 5  remember alcohol is a tool for some end not an end itself  people drink for a number of reasons  for most college kids and older its for social purposes  however remember these goals can only be reached within a limited spectrum of consumption  in other words if you want to be social then puking is not a good way to do it  so dont drink to that point its selfdefeating  if you drink for taste then remember that your taste buds will only dull if you drink too much and the taste of vomit isnt that wonderful either  so dont drink to that point if good taste is your goal  i have heard that college age kids drink for other nocturnal reasons or with other activities in mind  however even if you get married and its for procreation purposes only you arent physically capable of achieving those other goals if you drink too much  so regardless of your reason to drink remember that you have no reason to drink too much and actually plenty of good reasons not to drink too much  with that thought in mind you will find the other suggestions easier to followgt  gt 6  dont drink from clear containers  this suggestion actually comes from theodore roosevelt     teddys alcohol consumption could have been a potential scandal if he drank too much  on the other hand he hung around a bunch of macho guys always wanting to drink more  so he had a great deal of pressure from both sides  so teddys solution was to drink from a metal cup  that way no one knew how much teddy had drank because no one could see how much was still left in his cup  so this allowed him to only slowly sip or do the hollywood sip where you hold the beverage to your mouth and pretend to drink  it also stopped people from trying to refill his cup when empty because he would also say his cup was full and he would never let anyone look into his cup to tell if he was lying  in the modern era red solo cups make a wonderful substitute for metal cups  gt  gt 7  finally if you find yourself drunk shame on you get to water immediately sit in a safe public place or your home shut up and drink water until you can function normally again  if you are severely intoxicated greater shame on you make sure someone sober is present in case something bad happens and never fall asleep sitting up or on your back  also remember room temperature water is better than ice water since it will get into your system faster  whatever you do dont simply walk around and try to pretend you are not drunk also see suggestion one about driving ie dont  dont drink anything with caffeine because it takes water out of your system which you need and will make you an energetic drunk bad idea  and from a pk standpoint dont take the floor or even try to converse with other members in the hall  in fact avoid the hall unless there are no other safe locations downtown with available water  also dont simply stop drinking and wait until you sober up  speed up the process with water otherwise the longer youre intoxicated the longer you can do something stupid  also dont go to bed before drinking water  before bed you can keep water down and it will work into your system while you sleep  however if you have a hangover the next morning often the body will expel water you drink which leaves you wide awake but hungover  before going out downtown in college i kept a gallon of room temperature water on stand by  if i came home under the influence i would force myself to drink the entire gallon in an hour  just the thought of having to sit up late at night to chug a gallon of water was enough to keep me from going to far many times  also after you sober up learn from your mistake and plan differently gt  gt again these arent intended as encouragement to drink the only suggestions to follow legal advice or permission to break the law  instead my motivation was to help you help yourself if you choose that route  too often people new to alcohol are told to drink wisely but never told how to drink wisely  and it the important thing to remember when approaching anything biblical for the sake of taking specific verses and using them to forward a specific point / agenda is that the people of biblical times would have already understood all the stories / teachings and all that because the knowledge was usually already ingrained in their culture . so while the bible may speak " positively " of wine , it ' s important to remember that it is because wine served a social / cultural function for biblical folk back in the day . as a general rule of thumb , the bibles attitudes towards gluttony extend to include the consumption and therefore excess consumption of alcohol . a . k . a , getting drunk isn ' t necessarily " okay " or anything like that , and many biblical stories after frown on that . likewise one of mankinds earliest commissions in the bible is abstinence ( abstinence from the fruit from the tree of the knowledge of good and evil ) , abstinence is a continued subject of import within subsequent biblical teachings . this includes food , sex , alcohol , excess , what have you . so in short , sure the bible may speak of alcohol as being swell , but that ' s only because it was a social agent for those people ( as it has been throughout history ) , the bible still doesn ' t support drunkeness and out right denounces it in a couple passages . man i ' m drunk . all day out in 30 degree celsius weather , and one white russian later and i ' m feelin ' great . * * ninja edit ! ! : * * it ' s also worth noting that alcohol was likely safer to drink than water in those days which could have contributed to why it was so often consumed in every social setting . that being said , while the bible does say something like " drink and be merry ! " or whatever , " drink / merry " still doesn ' t necessarily mean " get completely sloshed and have a good time , " rather " alcohol may help in the loosening of social anxieties and may make an evening more pleasurable for everyone is consumed in a responsible manner ! " essentially the use of biblical verses to forward specific ideals ( in this case , the idea that the bible says alcohol is swell ) is known as biblicism or " biblical literalism " , an ideology which in itself is inherently flawed ; in trying to state how the bible serves to be an all - encompassing truth book that can be used as a general manual to ones approach to life , the bible falls short in actually being clear in what it is saying to be true . the masses of different denominations now present in protestant religion is a prime example of this ; they all want to say that their differences are tiny , but those very differences expose the fact that the bible is not clear in what it says is holy and isn ' t holy as all those denominations ( cultural influences aside ) cannot come to agreeance on different things . * * so essentially arguing for the bibles view on alcohol is reliant on a theological approach to the bible ( biblicism ) that is inherently flawed . * * sorry i ' m pretty drunk . * * ninja edit pt . 2 * * it ' s worth noting the only biblical literalists in the world are either a small portion of christian conservatives ( maybe groups of southern baptists ? ) and poignantly anti - religious folk who take the bible at face value and use it ' s various silly - sounding entries to forward their own beliefs ( e . g the bible / faith / religion is stupid ) . okay i ' m done so sorry so sorry . i don ' t know why i ' ve done this .

very basically , alcohol has two main effects : as others have mentioned , it is a gaba antagonist ( gaba receptors exist throughout the central nervous system ) . gaba is a neurotransmitter inhibitor , making it a sedative . alcohol is also serotonergic , meaning it interacts with 5 - ht receptor ( s ) , making it an " upper " . at first , the excess serotonin more than makes up for any sedative effects . eventually , your gaba receptors start to shut down your other neurotransmitters and the sedative effect takes over . that ' s why you initially get a rush of energy when you drink , but eventually will black out . alcohol also has an important secondary effect - weakening the blood - brain barrier . this allows more pathogens into the brain . ethanol ( alcohol ) also takes a huge amount of water to process , and most of that processing takes place overnight , resulting in dehydration . weakening of the blood - brain barrier + dehydration = hangover . also , props to google chrome . i couldn ' t have typed any of this right without ya .

ok now that you ' ve done that i ' ll give you some real advice . straight alcohol is a difficult thing for a novice to find palatable . i ' d recommend trying some highballs : rum and coke , vodka and anything * , gin and tonic , tequila and sprite , bourbon / rye and coke , rye and ginger ale are all options . use a jigger to pour your drinks , a standard highball is 1 . 5oz of liquor and about 4oz of mixer . never , ever drink on an empty stomach . don ' t drink too fast . don ' t do shots . drink plenty of water , before , after and during . have a bottle of gatorade and some tylenol on hand for the next morning . also , eating a decent breakfast is a good way to deal with a hangover . if you ingest too much alcohol too quickly your body will try to evacuate any alcohol in your stomach so you don ' t absorb anymore . in other words , if you drink too much too fast you ' re going to violently puke everywhere . that ' s why you eat first , food in your stomach will help slow the rate of absorption of alcohol so you don ' t get too drunk too quickly . further , you don ' t want to drink as much on a full stomach mostly because there isn ' t as much room for liquor . this is also the reason why you don ' t do shots and why you drink slowly . another reason , is blackouts . this is you losing a chunk of time and waking up the next morning and not knowing what in the fuck happened and where are your pants / cellphone / wallet / car keys . bad things can and will happen when you blackout . or they won ' t and your friends will tell you a funny story about how you made out with some ugly chick and danced like an idiot . it could go either way . you ' ve got to ask yourself , do i feel lucky ? well , do yah , punk ? i ' m recommending highballs because they taste good and are easy to pace yourself with . nothing complicated there . there , now you have the advice and the reasons why it ' s good advice . all i can say now is good luck , have fun , don ' t drink and drive , and i hope to see you here friday ! * vodka can be mixed with almost any soda or fruit juice because it has such a neutral flavor . start with screwdrivers ( vodka and orange juice ) and branch out from there . edit : forgot , alcohol dehydrates you which is why you want to drink water . being hydrated is a huge start in preventing severe hangovers .

i think it has everything to do with the way you want to drink . vodka lends itself very well to a handful of things : focusing on getting drunk quickly , trying to create a delicious drink with alcohol not being the main flavor , or creating a drink you want to sip on over conversation without the focus being on getting drunk . 1 . focusing on getting drunk quickly . short of fireball , plain vodka is the easiest liquor to take shots of . the flavor washes away quickly . while shots of tequila taste a lot like rubbing alcohol gone bad and whiskey has such a heavy mouth - feel that it seems like a chore , vodka is basically pungent water in terms of shot - taking . 2 . creating a drink that is delicious , but where alcohol is not the primary flavor . infusion plays a huge part of this , and vodka takes very well to infusion . want to create a lime and mint cocktail ? stick some lime rinds and fresh mint in your vodka and let it sit . want to create a strawberry lemonade ? infuse your strawberries in vodka and not only will you get an intense strawberry flavor , but you ' ll get little boozy strawberries for garnish . you can infuse vodka with nearly anything , and even make your own liqueurs . 3 . a drink to sip on over conversation . it ' s very easy to make a mixed drink with only a smidge of vodka , in such a way that it doesn ' t detract from the quality of the drink . club soda , lemon , lime and a tiny bit of vodka is a good example . you could also throw it in almost any kind of juice , soda or hot beverage . there is no undertone flavor to account for when using vodka , and it ' s very easy to adjust the dosage for any social situation .

it does give you worse hangovers , but it ' s because the standards for production are lower and so there are more impurities ( called congeners ) in the drink which are more toxic to your body than the standard ethanol that gets you drunk . top shelf alcohol is usually distilled several times and filtered , which removes those impurities , while you ' re lucky if the cheap stuff is even distilled more than once . there are exceptions to " cheap = less refined , " but the cheaper stuff is far more likely to wreak havoc on your body .

i don ' t have a dark backstory or inner demons that drive me into a bottle , but i do love to drink . here are a few reasons i can think of off the top of my head , and after a glass of whiskey : 1 . it ' s a social lubricant . it gets people out of their shells and talking and having a good time together , even if they ' re complete strangers . of course , it ' s best if you can genuinely be interested in others and be friendly and outgoing without using booze as a crutch , but not everybody can do that . 2 . the good stories . while it ' s true that everybody has had some awful experiences while drinking , a lot of the funniest and most memorable stories develop out of a drunken evening . 3 . the taste . i was a late bloomer when it comes to drinking . my first beer was at 16 , in grade 11 . it was , admittedly , a really cheap beer , and i thought it tasted absolutely vile . i had no idea how anybody actually enjoyed drinking , and for a long while , i really had to earn my drunken state . nowadays , though , i ' ve grown to like the taste of alcohol , and i love the different flavours of the different types . i even enjoy the shittiest of beers and liquor , the kind that burns all the way down , because i enjoy a bit of bite to my drinks . i also like spicy food , so there ' s probably a connection . 4 . drinking makes me happy . when i get that warm , tingly buzz of drunkenness , and i don ' t overdo it , i feel at ease , content , optimistic , confident , and sometimes even like a complete champion . it can be dangerous to think of alcohol as an easy path to enjoyment , but , as the saying goes , everything in moderation .

if you ' re paranoid about your health and asking here , probably . & gt ; * * low risk for developing an alcohol use disorder ( aud ) : * * & gt ; as defined by niaaa , for women , low - risk drinking is no more than 3 drinks on any single day and no more than 7 drinks per week . for men , it is defined as no more than 4 drinks on any single day and no more than 14 drinks per week . niaaa research shows that only about 2 in 100 people who drink within these limits have an aud . even within these limits , you can have problems if you drink too quickly or have other health issues . so , how much is a drink ? 1 . 5 fluid ounces of vodka , or about 44 ml . doing some basic math , a 1l bottle is about 22 drinks a week . i ' d imagine any health professional would tell you to cut back no matter your gender . also , remember that alcohol is calories . there ' s something like 217 calories in 100 ml , so you ' re drinking about 2 , 170 extra calories a week . that ' s like a day ' s caloric budget for an average man . if you want to cut back , maybe switch to better stuff that you sip rather than guzzle .
